name: Mom's Magic Cashew & Almond Cookies
ingredients_raw: MAIDA (REFINED WHEAT FLOUR), SUGAR, REFINED PALM OIL, INVERT SYRUP, NUTS (0.9%) [CASHEW NUTS (0.85%), ALMONDS (0.05%)], RAISING AGENTS [500(ii), 503(ii), 450(i)], IODIZED SALT, NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (BUTTER, NUT, VANILLA, MILK), EMULSIFIERS [MONO AND DIGLYCERIDES OF FATTY ACIDS (FROM PALM OIL), LECITHIN (FROM SOYABEAN), DIACETYLTARTARIC AND FATTY ACID ESTERS OF GLYCEROL (FROM SUNFLOWER AND PALM OIL)], ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (BUTTER), GHEE (0.01%), FLOUR TREATMENT AGENT (223), COLOUR (150a).
